title: List deployments
summary: List deployments newest first. Archived rows are excluded unless `include_archived=true` is passed.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Only deployments bound to this agent.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only deployments in this state.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: `true` also returns archived deployments.

parameters.name: created_at[gt|gte|lt|lte]
parameters.description: ISO 8601 bounds on creation time.

response.name: data
response.description: Deployments in the published shape: `type`, `id`, `name`, `description`, `agent`, `environment_id`, `initial_events`, `resources`, `vault_ids`, `schedule`, `status`, `paused_reason`, `metadata`, timestamps, `archived_at`.

title: Create deployment
summary: Create a deployment that starts a session for an agent, optionally on a cron schedule.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Human-readable deployment name.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Agent to deploy: an id for the current version, or `{type:"agent", id, version}` to pin. `agent_id` is accepted as a legacy alias.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: Environment each deployed session runs in.

parameters.name: initial_events
parameters.description: Events sent to each session on creation. `user.message`, `user.define_outcome`, and `system.message` are accepted; `user.tool_confirmation` is refused. At least one event is required.

parameters.name: schedule
parameters.description: `{type:"cron", expression, timezone}` for a recurring deployment. Omitted, the deployment only runs by hand. `schedule: null` on update removes the cadence.

parameters.name: cron
parameters.description: Legacy flat alias for `schedule.expression`.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Legacy flat alias for `schedule.timezone`. Defaults to `UTC`.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional description.

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: File and memory-store resources mounted into each session.

parameters.name: vault_ids
parameters.description: Credential vault ids available to each session.

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Session budget applied to each run.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: String-valued key pairs.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Initial state. Defaults to `active`.

parameters.name: next_run_at
parameters.description: Local extension: override for the computed next run time.

response.name: id
response.description: Server-generated `depl_...` identifier.

response.name: agent
response.description: `{type:"agent", id, version}` — the version pinned at create time.

response.name: schedule
response.description: `{type:"cron", expression, timezone, upcoming_runs_at}` — the next three scheduled instants — or null for a manual-only deployment.

response.name: status
response.description: Current pause state. An archived deployment still reports its pause state beside `archived_at`.

response.name: paused_reason
response.description: `{type:"manual"}` when paused by hand, `{type:"error", error}` when the runner paused it after a failed scheduled run.

title: List deployment runs
summary: List the deployment's recorded runs, newest first, in the published deployment-run shape.

response.name: data
response.description: Runs for this deployment, newest first, in the published run shape.

title: Run deployment
summary: Trigger the deployment immediately. Allowed while paused; creates the session from the deployment’s `initial_events` and records the run. Does not publish `deployment_run.*` webhook events — those belong to the timed path.

response.name: id
response.description: Run identifier, `drun_...`.

response.name: trigger_context
response.description: `{type:"manual"}` for a hand-triggered run.

response.name: session_id
response.description: Session the run created, or null when creation was rejected.

response.name: error
response.description: Classified `{type, message}` — e.g. `session_creation_rejected_error`, `environment_archived_error` — on a failed run.

title: Run due deployments
summary: Local extension: trigger every active deployment whose next run has arrived. Emits `deployment_run.started` and `deployment_run.succeeded`/`failed`, and `session.created` for each session it creates.

response.name: data
response.description: 202. The run records this pass produced for due deployments, newest first. A deployment archived because its agent is gone produces no run.
